objective: Track paid or token-compensated promotion as disclosed experiments only, with live-post evidence and conversion measurement before any repeat spend.

policy.preferredPaymentTiming: after approved deliverable is live and unchanged
policy.repeatSpendRule: Do not repeat paid promotion until live evidence, disclosure, unchanged copy, and conversion results are recorded.

approval.approvalBasis: manual DM negotiation and approved factual draft

compensation.paymentEvidence: transaction evidence not recorded in repository
compensation.paymentTimingRisk: paid before repository-verified live post evidence

approvedContentRequirements: must include SATA transparency report link
must include SATA X profile link
must include no price guarantee, no redemption promise, no financial advice, and liquidity risk language
must not include pump, guaranteed buyers, fake engagement, investor targeting, price prediction, or market-support claims

verification.result: X public crawl did not expose tweet contents; treat the post URL as user-supplied until a signed-in browser screenshot, permalink, or exported text verifies the exact live post.
requiredEvidence: screenshot or exported text showing disclosure and unchanged approved copy
record of any edits or deletion

campaigns.nextAction: Verify the X post from a signed-in browser or durable screenshot before counting the campaign as live or approving any repeat paid promotion.

nextAction: Verify diana-crypto-20260903-transparency-tweet, then record conversion results after 24 hours without making price or market-support claims.
boundary: This ledger tracks disclosed marketing experiments. It does not approve promotion, payment, token grants, asset movement, price claims, investor targeting, or repeat spend.
